name: investigation-where-config
task: Where does the service read its retry configuration from, and what happens when it's missing?

name: investigation-who-calls
task: Which modules call the report exporter, and do any of them run it inside a transaction?

name: investigation-why-flag
task: Why do we have both a legacy and a new code path for account merging? Was the legacy one ever supposed to be removed?

name: investigation-data-flow
task: How does an incoming webhook end up as a row in the events table? I just want to understand it, not change anything.

name: feature-export-csv
task: Add CSV export to the reports page, with the same filters the table uses.

name: feature-notification-prefs
task: Let users choose which email notifications they receive, per notification type.

name: feature-rate-limit
task: Add per-account rate limiting to the public API, configurable per plan.

name: feature-audit-log
task: We need an audit log of admin actions that admins can search by user and date.

name: feature-pause-resume
task: Build pause and resume for scheduled jobs, including what happens to runs that were due while paused.

name: bugfix-off-by-one
task: The paginated list skips the last item on every page. Fix it.

name: bugfix-500-on-empty
task: POST /widgets returns a 500 when the description field is empty instead of a validation error.

name: bugfix-timezone
task: Daily summaries are sent a day early for users in UTC-8. Customers are complaining.

name: bugfix-duplicate-events
task: Some events get processed twice after a worker restart. Find and fix the cause.

name: bugfix-flaky-test
task: The test for account deletion fails about one run in ten on CI. Make it reliable without just adding retries.

name: bugfix-regression
task: Since last week's release, search results are no longer sorted by relevance. Something broke it.

name: refactor-split-module
task: The orders service file is 2000 lines. Split it into sensible modules without changing behavior.

name: refactor-remove-duplication
task: We have three slightly different copies of the date parsing helper. Consolidate them.

name: refactor-deepen-module
task: Callers of the storage layer all repeat the same five steps. Restructure it so the module hides that.

name: refactor-rename-concept
task: We call the same thing 'tenant' in some places and 'workspace' in others. Unify on 'workspace' in the code, behavior must stay identical.

name: perf-slow-endpoint
task: The dashboard endpoint takes 4 seconds for large accounts. Make it faster and show me the numbers.

name: perf-memory
task: The import worker's memory grows until it gets killed on big files. Fix the memory use.

name: perf-build-time
task: Our test suite went from 3 to 9 minutes this month. Find out why and bring it down.

name: migration-api-version
task: Move every caller from the v1 client to the v2 client across the whole repo, then delete v1.

name: migration-logger
task: Replace all uses of the old logger helper with the structured logger in all 140 files.

name: migration-config-format
task: Convert every service's config from the old flat format to the new nested format and remove support for the old one.

name: explain-pr
task: Explain what PR 412 changes and what could break, I need to review it.

name: explain-subsystem
task: Teach me how the permissions subsystem works, diagram by diagram. I'm new to this part of the code.

name: explain-branch
task: Walk me through the changes on this branch as if I were reviewing them.

name: explain-onboarding
task: I'm onboarding a new teammate. Give me an explanation of the job scheduler they can read, with diagrams.

name: autonomous-overnight
task: The spec and tickets for the export feature are ready. Work through all the tickets overnight without me.

name: autonomous-loop
task: Keep going ticket by ticket on the approved plan until everything is done or you get blocked.

name: pickup-yesterday
task: Pick up where I left off yesterday on this branch.

name: pickup-handoff
task: Resume the work from the latest handoff note.

name: pause-end-of-day
task: I need to stop for today. Leave this in a state I can resume tomorrow.

name: pause-switch-context
task: Something urgent came up. Wrap up safely so I can come back to this later.

name: ship-open-pr
task: This is done. Verify it and open a PR.

name: ship-ready
task: Get this branch ready to merge: final checks, review, and a PR with a proper description.

name: ship-release
task: Ship the notification preferences branch.

name: feature-small-endpoint
task: Add an endpoint that returns the current user's last five logins.

name: bugfix-user-report
task: A user reports that changing their email logs them out of every device but the new email isn't saved.
